top_verses.text: When he had said this, he breathed on them; and he said to them: Receive ye the Holy Ghost.
top_verses.original_text: Haec cum dixisset, insufflavit, et dixit eis: Accipite Spiritum Sanctum:

top_verses.text: And he said to me: Prophesy to the spirit, prophesy, O son of man, and say to the spirit: Thus saith the Lord God: Come, spirit, from the four winds, and blow upon these slain, and let them live again.
top_verses.original_text: Et dixit ad me: Vaticinare ad spiritum: vaticinare, fili hominis, et dices ad spiritum: Haec dicit Dominus Deus: A quatuor ventis veni, spiritus, et insuffla super interfectos istos, et reviviscant.

top_verses.text: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spoke to him, taking away of the spirit that was in Moses, and giving to the seventy men. And when the spirit had rested on them they prophesied, nor did they cease afterwards.
top_verses.original_text: Descenditque Dominus per nubem, et locutus est ad eum, auferens de spiritu qui erat in Moyse, et dans septuaginta viris. Cumque requievisset in eis spiritus, prophetaverunt, nec ultra cessaverunt.

top_verses.text: In that same hour, he rejoiced in the Holy Ghost, and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hidden these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to little ones. Yea, Father, for so it hath seemed good in thy sight.
top_verses.original_text: In ipsa hora exsultavit Spiritu Sancto, et dixit: Confiteor tibi Pater, Domine caeli et terrae, quod abscondisti haec a sapientibus et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis. Etiam Pater: quoniam sic placuit ante te.

top_verses.text: But the spirit of the almighty God gave a great evidence of his presence, so that all that had presumed to obey him, falling down by the power of God, were struck with fainting and dread.
top_verses.original_text: Sed spiritus omnipotentis Dei magnam fecit suae ostensionis evidentiam, ita ut omnes qui ausi fuerant parere ei, ruentes Dei virtute, in dissolutionem et formidinem converterentur.

top_verses.text: And there arose a great cry. And some of the Pharisees rising up, strove, saying: We find no evil in this man. What if a spirit hath spoken to him, or an angel?
top_verses.original_text: Factus est autem clamor magnus. Et surgentes quidam pharisaeorum, pugnabant, dicentes: Nihil mali invenimus in homine isto: quid si spiritus locutus est ei, aut angelus?

top_verses.text: And they came to the foresaid hill, and behold a company of prophets met him: and the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he prophesied in the midst of them.
top_verses.original_text: Veneruntque ad praedictum collem, et ecce cuneus prophetarum obvius ei: et insiluit super eum spiritus Domini, et prophetavit in medio eorum.

top_verses.text: And the Holy Ghost descended in a bodily shape, as a dove upon him; and a voice came from heaven: Thou art my beloved Son; in thee I am well pleased.
top_verses.original_text: et descendit Spiritus Sanctus corporali specie sicut columba in ipsum: et vox de caelo facta est: Tu es filius meus dilectus, in te complacui mihi.

top_verses.text: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him: the spirit of wisdom, and of understanding, the spirit of counsel, and of fortitude, the spirit of knowledge, and of godliness.
top_verses.original_text: Et requiescet super eum spiritus Domini: spiritus sapientiae et intellectus, spiritus consilii et fortitudinis, spiritus scientiae et pietatis;

top_verses.text: For the spirit shall pass in him, and he shall not be: and he shall know his place no more.
top_verses.original_text: quoniam spiritus pertransibit in illo, et non subsistet, et non cognoscet amplius locum suum.

top_verses.text: He, that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith to the churches: To him, that overcometh, I will give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the paradise of my God.
top_verses.original_text: Qui habet aurem, audiat quid Spiritus dicat ecclesiis: Vincenti dabo edere de ligno vitae, quod est in paradiso Dei mei.

top_verses.text: How shall not the ministration of the spirit be rather in glory?
top_verses.original_text: quomodo non magis ministratio Spiritus erit in gloria?

top_verses.text: And the Spirit of the Lord shall come upon thee, and thou shalt prophesy with them, and shalt be changed into another man.
top_verses.original_text: Et insiliet in te spiritus Domini, et prophetabis cum eis, et mutaberis in virum alium.

top_verses.text: Else if thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that holdeth the place of the unlearned say, Amen, to thy blessing? because he knoweth not what thou sayest.
top_verses.original_text: Ceterum si benedixeris spiritu, qui supplet locum idiotae, quomodo dicet: Amen, super tuam benedictionem? quoniam quid dicas, nescit.

top_verses.text: The  spirit of the Lord is upon me, because the Lord hath anointed me: he hath sent me to preach to the meek, to heal the contrite of heart, and to preach a release to the captives, and deliverance to them that are shut up.
top_verses.original_text: Spiritus Domini super me, eo quod unxerit Dominus me; ad annuntiandum mansuetis misit me, ut mederer contritis corde, et praedicarem captivis indulgentiam, et clausis apertionem;

top_verses.text: If the spirit of him that hath power, ascend upon thee, leave not thy place: because care will make the greatest sins to cease.
top_verses.original_text: Si spiritus potestatem habentis ascenderit super te, locum tuum ne demiseris, quia curatio faciet cessare peccata maxima.

top_verses.text: And all flesh shall see, that I the Lord have kindled it, and it shall not be quenched.
top_verses.original_text: et videbit universa caro quia ego Dominus succendi eam, nec extinguetur.

top_verses.text: O hear my prayer: all flesh shall come to thee.
top_verses.original_text: Exaudi orationem meam; ad te omnis caro veniet.

top_verses.text: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will cause flesh to grow over you, and will cover you with skin: and I will give you spirit and you shall live, and you shall know that I am the Lord.
top_verses.original_text: Et dabo super vos nervos, et succrescere faciam super vos carnes, et superextendam in vobis cutem, et dabo vobis spiritum, et vivetis: et scietis quia ego Dominus.

top_verses.text: And thou shalt take the ram of the consecration, and shalt boil the flesh thereof in the holy place:
top_verses.original_text: Arietem autem consecrationis tolles, et coques carnes ejus in loco sancto:

top_verses.text: That no flesh should glory in his sight.
top_verses.original_text: ut non glorietur omnis caro in conspectu ejus.

top_verses.text: The flesh of man shall not be anointed therewith, and you shall make none other of the same composition, because it is sanctified, and shall be holy unto you.
top_verses.original_text: Caro hominis non ungetur ex eo, et juxta compositionem ejus non facietis aliud, quia sanctificatum est, et sanctum erit vobis.

top_verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Your slain, whom you have laid in the midst thereof, they are the flesh, and this is the caldron: and I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof.
top_verses.original_text: Propterea haec dicit Dominus Deus: Interfecti vestri, quos posuistis in medio ejus, hi sunt carnes, et haec est lebes: et educam vos de medio ejus.

top_verses.text: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh in its concupiscences.
top_verses.original_text: sed induimini Dominum Jesum Christum, et carnis curam ne feceritis in desideriis.

top_verses.text: And he that hath touched the uncleanness of man, or of beast, or of any thing that can defile, and shall eat of such kind of flesh, shall be cut off from his people.
top_verses.original_text: Et quae tetigerit immunditiam hominis, vel jumenti, sive omnis rei quae polluere potest, et comederit de hujuscemodi carnibus, interibit de populis suis.

top_verses.text: Yet now he hath reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unspotted, and blameless before him:
top_verses.original_text: nunc autem reconciliavit in corpore carnis ejus per mortem, exhibere vos sanctos, et immaculatos, et irreprehensibiles coram ipso:

top_verses.text: And the angel of the Lord said to him: Take the flesh and the unleavened loaves, and lay them upon that rock, and pour out the broth thereon. And when he had done so,
top_verses.original_text: Cui dixit angelus Domini: Tolle carnes et azymos panes, et pone supra petram illam, et jus desuper funde. Cumque fecisset ita,

top_verses.text: So that he will not give them of the flesh of his children, which he shall eat: because he hath nothing else in the siege and the want, wherewith thy enemies shall distress thee within all thy gates.
top_verses.original_text: ne det eis de carnibus filiorum suorum, quas comedet: eo quod nihil aliud habeat in obsidione et penuria, qua vastaverint te inimici tui intra omnes portas tuas.

top_verses.text: But when the live flesh shall appear in him,
top_verses.original_text: Quando vero caro vivens in eo apparuerit,

top_verses.text: And he remembered that they are flesh: a wind that goeth and returneth not.
top_verses.original_text: Et recordatus est quia caro sunt, spiritus vadens et non rediens.

top_verses.text: Shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat those things that are sanctified: but when he hath washed his flesh with water,
top_verses.original_text: immundus erit usque ad vesperum, et non vescetur his quae sanctificata sunt: sed cum laverit carnem suam aqua,

top_verses.text: But they that stood by, being moved with wicked pity, for the old friendship they had with the man, taking him aside, desired that flesh might be brought, which it was lawful for him to eat, that he might make as if he had eaten, as the king had commanded of the flesh of the sacrifice:
top_verses.original_text: Hi autem qui astabant, iniqua miseratione commoti propter antiquam viri amicitiam, tollentes eum secreto rogabant afferri carnes quibus vesci ei licebat, ut simularetur manducasse sicut rex imperaverat de sacrificii carnibus,

top_verses.text: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith: Sacrifice and oblation thou wouldest not: but a body thou hast fitted to me:
top_verses.original_text: Ideo ingrediens mundum dicit: Hostiam et oblationem noluisti: corpus autem aptasti mihi:

top_verses.text: And now I am not in the world, and these are in the world, and I come to thee. Holy Father, keep them in thy name whom thou hast given me; that they may be one, as we also are.
top_verses.original_text: Et jam non sum in mundo, et hi in mundo sunt, et ego ad te venio. Pater sancte, serva eos in nomine tuo, quos dedisti mihi: ut sint unum, sicut et nos.

top_verses.text: For God so loved the world, as to give his only begotten Son; that whosoever believeth in him, may not perish, but may have life everlasting.
top_verses.original_text: Sic enim Deus dilexit mundum, ut Filium suum unigenitum daret: ut omnis qui credit in eum, non pereat, sed habeat vitam aeternam.

top_verses.text: Which is come unto you, as also it is in the whole world, and bringeth forth fruit and groweth, even as it doth in you, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth.
top_verses.original_text: quod pervenit ad vos, sicut et in universo mundo est, et fructificat, et crescit sicut in vobis, ex ea die, qua audistis, et cognovistis gratiam Dei in veritate,

top_verses.text: For God sent not his Son into the world, to judge the world, but that the world may be saved by him.
top_verses.original_text: Non enim misit Deus Filium suum in mundum, ut judicet mundum, sed ut salvetur mundus per ipsum.

top_verses.text: Hearken, my dearest brethren: hath not God chosen the poor in this world, rich in faith, and heirs of the kingdom which God hath promised to them that love him?
top_verses.original_text: Audite, fratres mei dilectissimi: nonne Deus elegit pauperes in hoc mundo, divites in fide, et haeredes regni, quod repromisit Deus diligentibus se?

top_verses.text: The spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it seeth him not, nor knoweth him: but you shall know him; because he shall abide with you, and shall be in you.
top_verses.original_text: Spiritum veritatis, quem mundus non potest accipere, quia non videt eum, nec scit eum: vos autem cognoscetis eum, quia apud vos manebit, et in vobis erit.

top_verses.text: He that hath the substance of this world, and shall see his brother in need, and shall shut up his bowels from him: how doth the charity of God abide in him?
top_verses.original_text: Qui habuerit substantiam hujus mundi, et viderit fratrem suum necessitatem habere, et clauserit viscera sua ab eo: quomodo caritas Dei manet in eo?

top_verses.text: The soul that eateth that which died of itself, or has been caught by a beast, whether he be one of your own country or a stranger, shall wash his clothes and himself with water, and shall be defiled until the evening: and in this manner he shall be made clean.
top_verses.original_text: Anima, quae comederit morticinum, vel captum a bestia, tam de indigenis, quam de advenis, lavabit vestimenta sua et semetipsum aqua, et contaminatus erit usque ad vesperum: et hoc ordine mundus fiet.

top_verses.text: If such a man cast his spittle upon him that is clean, he shall wash his clothes: and being washed with water, he shall be unclean until the evening.
top_verses.original_text: Si salivam hujuscemodi homo jecerit super eum qui mundus est, lavabit vestimenta sua: et lotus aqua, immundus erit usque ad vesperum.

top_verses.text: And in this manner he that is clean shall purify the unclean on the third and on the seventh day. And being expiated the seventh day, he shall wash both himself and his garments, and be unclean until the evening.
top_verses.original_text: atque hoc modo mundus lustrabit immundum tertio et septimo die: expiatusque die septimo, lavabit et se et vestimenta sua, et immundus erit usque ad vesperum.

top_verses.text: The flesh that hath touched any unclean thing, shall not be eaten, but shall be burnt with fire: he that is clean shall eat of it.
top_verses.original_text: Caro, quae aliquid tetigerit immundum, non comedetur, sed comburetur igni: qui fuerit mundus, vescetur ex ea.

top_verses.text: If on the seventh day the evil seem to have stayed in its place, and not lower than the other flesh, he shall cleanse him, and his clothes being washed he shall be clean.
top_verses.original_text: Si die septimo visa fuerit stetisse plaga in loco suo, nec humilior carne reliqua, mundabit eum: lotisque vestibus suis, mundus erit.

top_verses.text: The priest shall view him, and shall judge him to be clean.
top_verses.original_text: considerabit eum sacerdos, et mundum esse decernet.

top_verses.text: Who can make him clean that is conceived of unclean seed? is it not thou who only art?
top_verses.original_text: Quis potest facere mundum de immundo conceptum semine? nonne tu qui solus es?

top_verses.text: But they gainsaying and blaspheming, he shook his garments, and said to them: Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean: from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles.
top_verses.original_text: Contradicentibus autem eis, et blasphemantibus, excutiens vestimenta sua, dixit ad eos: Sanguis vester super caput vestrum: mundus ego: ex hoc ad gentes vadam.

top_verses.text: And the altars that were upon the top of the upper chamber of Achaz, which the kings of Juda had made, and the altars which Manasses had made in the two courts of the temple of the Lord, the king broke down: and he ran from thence, and cast the ashes of them into the torrent Cedron.
top_verses.original_text: Altaria quoque quae erant super tecta coenaculi Achaz, quae fecerant reges Juda, et altaria quae fecerat Manasses in duobus atriis templi Domini, destruxit rex, et cucurrit inde, et dispersit cinerem eorum in torrentem Cedron.

top_verses.text: And Joiada the high priest took a chest and bored a hole in the top, and set it by the altar at the right hand of them that came into the house of the Lord, and the priests that kept the doors put therein all the money that was brought to the temple of the Lord.
top_verses.original_text: Et tulit Jojada pontifex gazophylacium unum, aperuitque foramen desuper, et posuit illud juxta altare ad dexteram ingredientium domum Domini: mittebantque in eo sacerdotes qui custodiebant ostia, omnem pecuniam quae deferebatur ad templum Domini.

top_verses.text: But he finding himself notably prevented by the man, came to the great and holy temple: and commanded the priests that were offering the accustomed sacrifices, to deliver him the man.
top_verses.original_text: Quod cum ille cognovit, fortiter se a viro praeventum, venit ad maximum et sanctissimum templum: et sacerdotibus solitas hostias offerentibus, jussit sibi tradi virum.

top_verses.text: And all the furniture of the temple, which king Achaz in his reign had defiled, after his transgression; and behold they are all set forth before the altar of the Lord.
top_verses.original_text: cunctamque templi supellectilem, quam polluerat rex Achaz in regno suo, postquam praevaricatus est: et ecce exposita sunt omnia coram altare Domini.

top_verses.text: And he set all the people with swords in their hands from the right side of the temple, to the left side of the temple, before the altar, and the temple, round about the king.
top_verses.original_text: Constituitque omnem populum tenentium pugiones a parte templi dextra, usque ad partem templi sinistram, coram altari et templo, per circuitum regis.

top_verses.text: And they came to Jerusalem. And when he was entered into the temple, he began to cast out them that sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers, and the chairs of them that sold doves.
top_verses.original_text: Et veniunt in Jerosolymam. Et cum introisset in templum, coepit ejicere vendentes et ementes in templo: et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:

top_verses.text: The holy temple also which before he had spoiled, he promiseth to adorn with goodly gifts, and to multiply the holy vessels, and to allow out of his revenues the charges pertaining to the sacrifices.
top_verses.original_text: templum etiam sanctum, quod prius expoliaverat, optimis donis ornaturum, et sancta vasa multiplicaturum, et pertinentes ad sacrificia sumptus de redditibus suis praestaturum:

top_verses.text: And all the people of the land went into the temple of Baal, and broke down his altars, and his images they broke in pieces thoroughly: they slew also Mathan the priest of Baal before the altar. And the priest set guards in the house of the Lord.
top_verses.original_text: Ingressusque est omnis populus terrae templum Baal, et destruxerunt aras ejus, et imagines contriverunt valide: Mathan quoque sacerdotem Baal occiderunt coram altari. Et posuit sacerdos custodias in domo Domini.

top_verses.text: And the Lord said to me: Son of man, attend with thy heart, and behold with thy eyes, and hear with thy ears, all that I say to thee concerning all the ceremonies of the house of the Lord, and concerning all the laws thereof: and mark well the ways of the temple, with all the goings out of the sanctuary.
top_verses.original_text: Et dixit ad me Dominus: Fili hominis, pone cor tuum, et vide oculis tuis, et auribus tuis audi omnia quae ego loquor ad te de universis caeremoniis domus Domini, et de cunctis legibus ejus: et pones cor tuum in viis templi per omnes exitus sanctuarii.

top_verses.text: And they come again to Jerusalem. And when he was walking in the temple, there come to him the chief priests and the scribes and the ancients,
top_verses.original_text: Et veniunt rursus Jerosolymam. Et cum ambularet in templo, accedunt ad eum summi sacerdotes, et scribae, et seniores:

top_verses.text: And said to him: Take these vessels, and go, and put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in its place.
top_verses.original_text: dixitque ei: Haec vasa tolle, et vade, et pone ea in templo, quod est in Jerusalem, et domus Dei aedificetur in loco suo.

top_verses.text: But there is only this, for which thou shalt entreat the Lord for thy servant, when my master goeth into the temple of Remmon, to worship: and he leaneth upon my hand, if I bow down in the temple of Remmon, when he boweth down in the same place, that the Lord pardon me thy servant for this thing.
top_verses.original_text: Hoc autem solum est, de quo depreceris Dominum pro servo tuo, quando ingredietur dominus meus templum Remmon ut adoret: et illo innitente super manum meam, si adoravero in templo Remmon, adorante eo in eodem loco, ut ignoscat mihi Dominus servo tuo pro hac re.

top_verses.text: Afterwards, Jesus findeth him in the temple, and saith to him: Behold thou art made whole: sin no more, lest some worse thing happen to thee.
top_verses.original_text: Postea invenit eum Jesus in templo, et dixit illi: Ecce sanus factus es; jam noli peccare, ne deterius tibi aliquid contingat.

top_verses.text: And swore, saying: Unless you deliver Judas prisoner to me, I will lay this temple of God even with the ground, and will beat down the altar, and I will dedicate this temple to Bacchus.
top_verses.original_text: juravit, dicens: Nisi Judam mihi vinctum tradideritis, istud Dei fanum in planitiem deducam, et altare effodiam, et templum hoc Libero patri consecrabo.

top_verses.text: And they forsook the temple of the Lord the God of their fathers, and served groves and idols, and wrath came upon Juda and Jerusalem for this sin.
top_verses.original_text: Et dereliquerunt templum Domini Dei patrum suorum, servieruntque lucis et sculptilibus: et facta est ira contra Judam et Jerusalem propter hoc peccatum.

top_verses.text: And they called upon the Lord that he would look upon his people that was trodden down by all, and would have pity on the temple, that was defiled by the wicked:
top_verses.original_text: Et invocabant Dominum, ut respiceret in populum qui ab omnibus calcabatur, et misereretur templo quod contaminabatur ab impiis:

top_verses.text: And thou shalt say to them: Thus saith the Lord: If you will not hearken to me to walk in my law, which I have given you:
top_verses.original_text: Et dices ad eos: Haec dicit Dominus: Si non audieritis me, ut ambuletis in lege mea quam dedi vobis,

top_verses.text: Cursed be he that abideth not in the words of this law, and fulfilleth them not in work: and all the people shall say: Amen.
top_verses.original_text: Maledictus qui non permanet in sermonibus legis hujus, nec eos opere perficit: et dicet omnis populus: Amen.

top_verses.text: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, by transgression of the law dishonourest God.
top_verses.original_text: qui in lege gloriaris, per praevaricationem legis Deum inhonoras.

top_verses.text: But the law is not of faith: but, He that doth those things, shall live in them.
top_verses.original_text: Lex autem non est ex fide, sed: Qui fecerit ea, vivet in illis.

top_verses.text: Let all we have be subject to thy law.
top_verses.original_text: sint omnia nostra sub lege tua.

top_verses.text: If thou wilt not keep, and fulfil all the words of this law, that are written in this volume, and fear his glorious and terrible name: that is, The Lord thy God:
top_verses.original_text: Nisi custodieris et feceris omnia verba legis hujus, quae scripta sunt in hoc volumine, et timueris nomen ejus gloriosum et terribile, hoc est, Dominum Deum tuum:

top_verses.text: Let not the book of this law depart from thy mouth: but thou shalt meditate on it day and night, that thou mayst observe and do all things that are written in it: then shalt thou direct thy way, and understand it.
top_verses.original_text: Non recedat volumen legis hujus ab ore tuo: sed meditaberis in eo diebus ac noctibus, ut custodias et facias omnia quae scripta sunt in eo: tunc diriges viam tuam, et intelliges eam.

top_verses.text: Because by the works of the law no flesh shall be justified before him. For by the law is the knowledge of sin.
top_verses.original_text: quia ex operibus legis non justificabitur omnis caro coram illo. Per legem enim cognitio peccati.

top_verses.text: And the Lord testified to them in Israel and in Juda by the hand of all the prophets and seers, saying: Return from your wicked ways, and keep my precepts, and ceremonies, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers: and as I have sent to you in the hand of my servants the prophets.
top_verses.original_text: Et testificatus est Dominus in Israel et in Juda per manum omnium prophetarum et videntium, dicens: Revertimini a viis vestris pessimis, et custodite praecepta mea et caeremonias, juxta omnem legem quam praecepi patribus vestris, et sicut misi ad vos in manu servorum meorum prophetarum.

top_verses.text: And he commanded Juda to seek the Lord the God of their fathers, and to do the law, and all the commandments.
top_verses.original_text: et praecepit Judae ut quaereret Dominum Deum patrum suorum, et faceret legem, et universa mandata:

top_verses.text: Then they answered, and said before the king: Daniel, who is of the children of the captivity of Juda, hath not regarded thy law, nor the decree that thou hast made: but three times a day he maketh his prayer.
top_verses.original_text: Tunc respondentes dixerunt coram rege: Daniel de filiis captivitatis Juda, non curavit de lege tua, et de edicto quod constituisti: sed tribus temporibus per diem orat obsecratione sua.

top_verses.text: As thou spokest by the hand of thy servant Moses, in the day when thou didst command him to write thy law before the children of Israel,
top_verses.original_text: sicut locutus es in manu pueri tui Moysi, in die qua praecepisti ei scribere legem tuam coram filiis Israel,

top_verses.text: And how he gave them the law that they should not forget the commandments of the Lord, and that they should not err in their minds, seeing the idols of gold, and silver, and the ornaments of them.
top_verses.original_text: Et dedit illis legem, ne obliviscerentur praecepta Domini, et non exerrarent mentibus, videntes simulacra aurea et argentea, et ornamenta eorum.

top_verses.text: And they stood in their order according to the disposition, and law of Moses the man of God: but the priests received the blood which was to be poured out, from the hands of the Levites,
top_verses.original_text: steteruntque in ordine suo juxta dispositionem et legem Moysi hominis Dei: sacerdotes vero suscipiebant effundendum sanguinem de manibus Levitarum,

top_verses.text: Moses commanded a law in the precepts of justices, and an inheritance to the house of Jacob, and the promises to Israel.
top_verses.original_text: Legem mandavit Moyses in praeceptis justitiarum, et haereditatem domui Jacob, et Israel promissiones.

top_verses.text: Now when Daniel knew this, that is to say, that the law was made, he went into his house: and opening the windows in his upper chamber towards Jerusalem, he knelt down three times a day, and adored, and gave thanks before his God, as he had been accustomed to do before.
top_verses.original_text: Quod cum Daniel comperisset, id est, constitutam legem, ingressus est domum suam: et fenestris apertis in coenaculo suo contra Jerusalem tribus temporibus in die flectebat genua sua, et adorabat, confitebaturque coram Deo suo sicut et ante facere consueverat.

top_verses.text: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and he shewed them his justice and judgments.
top_verses.original_text: Testamentum aeternum constituit cum illis, et justitiam et judicia sua ostendit illis.

top_verses.text: And he was mindful of his covenant: and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
top_verses.original_text: Et memor fuit testamenti sui, et poenituit eum secundum multitudinem misericordiae suae:

top_verses.text: He made an everlasting covenant with him, and gave him the priesthood of the nation, and made him blessed in glory,
top_verses.original_text: Statuit ei testamentum aeternum, et dedit illi sacerdotium gentis, et beatificavit illum in gloria:

top_verses.text: He hath sent redemption to his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever. Holy and terrible is his name:
top_verses.original_text: Redemptionem misit populo suo; mandavit in aeternum testamentum suum. Sanctum et terribile nomen ejus.

top_verses.text: to such as keep his covenant, And are mindful of his commandments to do them.
top_verses.original_text: his qui servant testamentum ejus, et memores sunt mandatorum ipsius ad faciendum ea.

top_verses.text: This was made to him for an everlasting testament, and to his seed as the days of heaven, to execute the office of the priesthood, and to have praise, and to glorify his people in his name.
top_verses.original_text: Factum est illi in testamentum aeternum, et semini ejus, sicut dies caeli, fungi sacerdotio, et habere laudem, et glorificare populum suum in nomine ejus.

top_verses.text: And if not for their sakes, yet for the covenant that he had made with their fathers, and for the sake of his holy and glorious name that was invoked upon them.
top_verses.original_text: etsi non propter eos, propter testamentum tamen quod erat ad patres eorum, et propter invocationem sancti et magnifici nominis ejus super ipsos.

top_verses.text: Therefore he made to him a covenant of peace, to be the prince of the sanctuary, and of his people, that the dignity of priesthood should be to him and to his seed for ever.
top_verses.original_text: Ideo statuit illi testamentum pacis, principem sanctorum et gentis suae, ut sit illi et semini ejus sacerdotii dignitas in aeternum.

top_verses.text: And this is the testament which I will make unto them after those days, saith the Lord. I will give my laws in their hearts, and on their minds will I write them:
top_verses.original_text: Hoc autem testamentum, quod testabor ad illos post dies illos, dicit Dominus, dando leges meas in cordibus eorum, et in mentibus eorum superscribam eas:

top_verses.text: And this is to them my covenant: when I shall take away their sins.
top_verses.original_text: Et hoc illis a me testamentum: cum abstulero peccata eorum.

top_verses.text: To perform mercy to our fathers, and to remember his holy testament,
top_verses.original_text: ad faciendam misericordiam cum patribus nostris: et memorari testamenti sui sancti:

top_verses.text: And he said to them: This is my blood of the new testament, which shall be shed for many.
top_verses.original_text: Et ait illis: Hic est sanguis meus novi testamenti, qui pro multis effundetur.

top_verses.text: Gather ye together his saints to him: who set his covenant before sacrifices.
top_verses.original_text: Congregate illi sanctos ejus, qui ordinant testamentum ejus super sacrificia.

top_verses.text: Saying: This is the blood of the testament, which God hath enjoined unto you.
top_verses.original_text: dicens: Hic sanguis testamenti, quod mandavit ad vos Deus.

top_verses.text: Thou hast overthrown the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his sanctuary on the earth.
top_verses.original_text: Evertisti testamentum servi tui; profanasti in terra sanctuarium ejus.

top_verses.text: For finding fault with them, he saith: Behold, the days shall come, saith the Lord: and I will perfect unto the house of Israel, and unto the house of Juda, a new testament:
top_verses.original_text: Vituperans enim eos dicit: Ecce dies venient, dicit Dominus: et consummabo super domum Israel, et super domum Juda, testamentum novum,

top_verses.text: And he saith to them: It is written, My house shall be called the house of prayer; but you have made it a den of thieves.
top_verses.original_text: et dicit eis: Scriptum est: Domus mea domus orationis vocabitur: vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.

top_verses.text: And this house shall be made an example of: every one that shall pass by it, shall be astonished, and shall hiss, and say: Why hath the Lord done thus to this land, and to this house:
top_verses.original_text: Et domus haec erit in exemplum: omnis qui transierit per eam, stupebit, et sibilabit, et dicet: Quare fecit Dominus sic terrae huic, et domui huic?

top_verses.text: And this house shall be for a proverb to all that pass by, and they shall be astonished and say: Why hath the Lord done thus to this land, and to this house?
top_verses.original_text: Et domus ista erit in proverbium universis transeuntibus, et dicent stupentes: Quare fecit Dominus sic terrae huic, et domui huic?

top_verses.text: And the Lord said to me: Son of man, attend with thy heart, and behold with thy eyes, and hear with thy ears, all that I say to thee concerning all the ceremonies of the house of the Lord, and concerning all the laws thereof: and mark well the ways of the temple, with all the goings out of the sanctuary.
top_verses.original_text: Et dixit ad me Dominus: Fili hominis, pone cor tuum, et vide oculis tuis, et auribus tuis audi omnia quae ego loquor ad te de universis caeremoniis domus Domini, et de cunctis legibus ejus: et pones cor tuum in viis templi per omnes exitus sanctuarii.

top_verses.text: And all the multitude made a covenant with the king in the house of God: and Joiada said to them: Behold the king’s son shall reign, as the Lord hath said of the sons of David.
top_verses.original_text: Iniit ergo omnis multitudo pactum in domo Dei cum rege, dixitque ad eos Jojada: Ecce filius regis regnabit, sicut locutus est Dominus super filios David.

top_verses.text: And the Lord said to him: I have heard thy prayer and thy supplication, which thou hast made before me: I have sanctified this house, which thou hast built, to put my name there for ever, and my eyes and my heart shall be there always.
top_verses.original_text: Dixitque Dominus ad eum: Exaudivi orationem tuam et deprecationem tuam, quam deprecatus es coram me: sanctificavi domum hanc quam aedificasti, ut ponerem nomen meum ibi in sempiternum, et erunt oculi mei et cor meum ibi cunctis diebus.

top_verses.text: Go, and say to my servant David: Thus saith the Lord: Shalt thou build me a house to dwell in?
top_verses.original_text: Vade, et loquere ad servum meum David: Haec dicit Dominus: Numquid tu aedificabis mihi domum ad habitandum?

top_verses.text: And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, in the house of David his servant:
top_verses.original_text: et erexit cornu salutis nobis in domo David pueri sui,

top_verses.text: Therefore thou shalt say to the house of Israel: Thus saith the Lord God: It is not for your sake that I will do this, O house of Israel, but for my holy name’s sake, which you have profaned among the nations whither you went.
top_verses.original_text: Idcirco dices domui Israel: Haec dicit Dominus Deus: Non propter vos ego faciam, domus Israel, sed propter nomen sanctum meum, quod polluistis in gentibus ad quas intrastis.

top_verses.text: And thou shalt say to the house of Israel that provoketh me: Thus saith the Lord God: Let all your wicked doings suffice you, O house of Israel:
top_verses.original_text: Et dices ad exasperantem me domum Israel: Haec dicit Dominus Deus: Sufficiant vobis omnia scelera vestra, domus Israel:

top_verses.text: For thus saith the Lord of hosts the God of Israel, to the vessels that are left in the house of the Lord, and in the house of the king of Juda and Jerusalem:
top_verses.original_text: quia haec dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israel, ad vasa quae derelicta sunt in domo Domini, et in domo regis Juda et Jerusalem:

top_verses.text: Said to me: Son of man, the place of my throne, and the place of the soles of my feet, where I dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever: and the house of Israel shall no more profane my holy name, they and their kings by their fornications, and by the carcasses of their kings, and by the high places.
top_verses.original_text: dixit ad me: Fili hominis, locus solii mei, et locus vestigiorum pedum meorum, ubi habito in medio filiorum Israel in aeternum: et non polluent ultra domus Israel nomen sanctum meum, ipsi et reges eorum, in fornicationibus suis, et in ruinis regum suorum, et in excelsis.

top_verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God: When I shall have gathered together the house of Israel out of the people among whom they are scattered: I will be sanctified in them before the Gentiles: and they shall dwell in their own land, which I gave to my servant Jacob.
top_verses.original_text: Haec dicit Dominus Deus: Quando congregavero domum Israel de populis in quibus dispersi sunt, sanctificabor in eis coram gentibus: et habitabunt in terra sua, quam dedi servo meo Jacob:

top_verses.text: For thus saith the Lord to the house of Israel: Seek ye me, and you shall live.
top_verses.original_text: Quia haec dicit Dominus domui Israel: Quaerite me, et vivetis.

top_verses.text: Thus saith the Lord against all my wicked neighbours, that touch the inheritance that I have shared out to my people Israel: Behold I will pluck them out of their land, and I will pluck the house of Juda out of the midst of them.
top_verses.original_text: Haec dicit Dominus adversum omnes vicinos meos pessimos, qui tangunt haereditatem quam distribui populo meo Israel: Ecce ego evellam eos de terra sua, et domum Juda evellam de medio eorum.

top_verses.text: And as for you, O house of Israel: thus saith the Lord God: Walk ye every one after your idols, and serve them. But if in this also you hear me not, but defile my holy name any more with your gifts, and with your idols;
top_verses.original_text: Et vos, domus Israel, haec dicit Dominus Deus: Singuli post idola vestra ambulate, et servite eis. Quod si et in hoc non audieritis me, et nomen meum sanctum pollueritis ultra in muneribus vestris et in idolis vestris:

top_verses.text: And now thus shalt thou speak to my servant David: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: I took thee out of the pastures from following the sheep to be ruler over my people Israel:
top_verses.original_text: Et nunc haec dices servo meo David: Haec dicit Dominus exercituum: Ego tuli te de pascuis sequentem greges, ut esses dux super populum meum Israel:

top_verses.text: Now therefore thus shalt thou say to my servant David: Thus saith the Lord of hosts: I took thee from the pastures, from following the flock, that thou shouldst be ruler of my people Israel.
top_verses.original_text: Nunc itaque sic loqueris ad servum meum David: Haec dicit Dominus exercituum: Ego tuli te, cum in pascuis sequereris gregem, ut esses dux populi mei Israel:

top_verses.text: And David said: O Lord God of Israel, thy servant hath heard a report, that Saul designeth to come to Ceila, to destroy the city for my sake:
top_verses.original_text: Et ait David: Domine Deus Israel, audivit famam servus tuus, quod disponat Saul venire in Ceilam, ut evertat urbem propter me:

top_verses.text: And David said to him: To whom dost thou belong? or whence dost thou come? and whither art thou going? He said: I am a young man of Egypt, the servant of an Amalecite, and my master left me, because I began to be sick three days ago.
top_verses.original_text: Dixit itaque ei David: Cujus es tu? vel unde? et quo pergis? Qui ait: Puer aegyptius ego sum, servus viri Amalecitae: dereliquit autem me dominus meus, quia aegrotare coepi nudiustertius.

top_verses.text: So they girded sackcloths on their loins, and put ropes on their heads, and came to the king of Israel, and said to him: Thy servant Benadad saith: I beseech thee let me have my life. And he said: If he be yet alive he is my brother.
top_verses.original_text: Accinxerunt saccis lumbos suos, et posuerunt funiculos in capitibus suis, veneruntque ad regem Israel, et dixerunt ei: Servus tuus Benadad dicit: Vivat, oro te, anima mea. Et ille ait: Si adhuc vivit, frater meus est.

top_verses.text: And one of his servants said: No one, my lord O king: but Eliseus the prophet, that is in Israel, telleth the king of Israel all the words, that thou speakest in thy privy chamber.
top_verses.original_text: Dixitque unus servorum ejus: Nequaquam, domine mi rex, sed Eliseus propheta qui est in Israel, indicat regi Israel omnia verba quaecumque locutus fueris in conclavi tuo.

top_verses.text: And thou shalt say to them: Thus saith the Lord of hosts the God of Israel: Behold I will send, and take Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon my servant: and I will set his throne over these stones which I have hid, and he shall set his throne over them.
top_verses.original_text: et dices ad eos: Haec dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israel: Ecce ego mittam et assumam Nabuchodonosor regem Babylonis, servum meum: et ponam thronum ejus super lapides istos quos abscondi, et statuet solium suum super eos:

top_verses.text: And the servants of David said to him: Behold the day, of which the Lord said to thee: I will deliver thy enemy unto thee, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good in thy eyes. Then David arose, and secretly cut off the hem of Saul’s robe.
top_verses.original_text: Et dixerunt servi David ad eum: Ecce dies de qua locutus est Dominus ad te: Ego tradam tibi inimicum tuum, ut facias ei sicut placuerit in oculis tuis. Surrexit ergo David, et praecidit oram chlamydis Saul silenter.

top_verses.text: Blessed are those servants, whom the Lord when he cometh, shall find watching. Amen I say to you, that he will gird himself, and make them sit down to meat, and passing will minister unto them.
top_verses.original_text: Beati servi illi quos, cum venerit dominus, invenerit vigilantes: amen dico vobis, quod praecinget se, et faciet illos discumbere, et transiens ministrabit illis.

top_verses.text: And his lord answering, said to him: Wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sow not, and gather where I have not strewed:
top_verses.original_text: Respondens autem dominus ejus, dixit ei: Serve male, et piger, sciebas quia meto ubi non semino, et congrego ubi non sparsi:

top_verses.text: And his brethren came to him: and worshipping prostrate on the ground they said: We are thy servants.
top_verses.original_text: Veneruntque ad eum fratres sui: et proni adorantes in terram, dixerunt: Servi tui sumus.

top_verses.text: But if that servant shall say in his heart: My Lord is long a coming; and shall begin to strike the menservants and maidservants, and to eat and to drink and be drunk:
top_verses.original_text: Quod si dixerit servus ille in corde suo: Moram facit dominus meus venire: et coeperit percutere servos, et ancillas, et edere, et bibere, et inebriari:

top_verses.text: The lord of that servant will come in the day that he hopeth not, and at the hour that he knoweth not, and shall separate him, and shall appoint him his portion with unbelievers.
top_verses.original_text: veniet dominus servi illius in die qua non sperat, et hora qua nescit, et dividet eum, partemque ejus cum infidelibus ponet.

top_verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God: Behold my servants shall eat, and you shall be hungry: behold my servants shall drink, and you shall be thirsty.
top_verses.original_text: Propter hoc haec dicit Dominus Deus: Ecce servi mei comedent, et vos esurietis; ecce servi mei bibent, et vos sitietis;

top_verses.text: And he came to the king, and said to him: Behold thy servant’s sheep are shorn. Let the king, I pray, with his servants come to his servant.
top_verses.original_text: venitque ad regem, et ait ad eum: Ecce tondentur oves servi tui: veniat, oro, rex cum servis suis ad servum suum.

top_verses.text: I beseech thee, O Lord, let thy ear be attentive to the prayer of thy servant, and to the prayer of thy servants who desire to fear thy name: and direct thy servant this day, and give him mercy before this man. For I was the king’s cupbearer.
top_verses.original_text: Obsecro, Domine, sit auris tua attendens ad orationem servi tui, et ad orationem servorum tuorum, qui volunt timere nomen tuum: et dirige servum tuum hodie, et da ei misericordiam ante virum hunc. Ego enim eram pincerna regis.

entity__jesus_christ_vul.title: Jesus Christ the Messiah
entity__jesus_christ_vul.description: The Savior Jesus Christ (Iesus Christus) throughout Gospels and Latin New Testament.

top_verses.text: Jesus saith to him: Arise, take up thy bed, and walk.
top_verses.original_text: Dicit ei Jesus: Surge, tolle grabatum tuum et ambula.

top_verses.text: And Jesus saith to him: Go thy way, thy faith hath made thee whole. And immediately he saw, and followed him in the way.
top_verses.original_text: Jesus autem ait illi: Vade, fides tua te salvum fecit. Et confestim vidit, et sequebatur eum in via.

top_verses.text: And Jesus said to him: Friend, whereto art thou come? Then they came up, and laid hands on Jesus, and held him.
top_verses.original_text: Dixitque illi Jesus: Amice, ad quid venisti? Tunc accesserunt, et manus injecerunt in Jesum, et tenuerunt eum.

top_verses.text: And beholding Jesus walking, he saith: Behold the Lamb of God.
top_verses.original_text: Et respiciens Jesum ambulantem, dicit: Ecce agnus Dei.

top_verses.text: At that time Jesus answered and said: I confess to thee, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them to little ones.
top_verses.original_text: In illo tempore respondens Jesus dixit: Confiteor tibi, Pater, Domine caeli et terrae, quia abscondisti haec a sapientibus, et prudentibus, et revelasti ea parvulis.

top_verses.text: Then Jesus said to them: Amen, amen I say unto you: Except you eat the flesh of the Son of man, and drink his blood, you shall not have life in you.
top_verses.original_text: Dixit ergo eis Jesus: Amen, amen dico vobis: nisi manducaveritis carnem Filii hominis, et biberitis ejus sanguinem, non habebitis vitam in vobis.

top_verses.text: And when they came to Jesus, they besought him earnestly, saying to him: He is worthy that thou shouldest do this for him.
top_verses.original_text: At illi cum venissent ad Jesum, rogabant eum sollicite, dicentes ei: Quia dignus est ut hoc illi praestes:

top_verses.text: Jesus answering, said: Amen I say to you, there is no man who hath left house or brethren, or sisters, or father, or mother, or children, or lands, for my sake and for the gospel,
top_verses.original_text: Respondens Jesus, ait: Amen dico vobis: Nemo est qui reliquerit domum, aut fratres, aut sorores, aut patrem, aut matrem, aut filios, aut agros propter me et propter Evangelium,

entity__lord_god_vul.title: The LORD God Almighty
entity__lord_god_vul.description: Dominus Deus, the Lord God of heaven and earth.

top_verses.text: All that were in Juda with a curse: for with all their heart they swore, and with all their will they sought him, and they found him, and the Lord gave them rest round about.
top_verses.original_text: omnes qui erant in Juda, cum execratione: in omni enim corde suo juraverunt, et in tota voluntate quaesierunt eum, et invenerunt: praestititque eis Dominus requiem per circuitum.

top_verses.text: And the servants of David said to him: Behold the day, of which the Lord said to thee: I will deliver thy enemy unto thee, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good in thy eyes. Then David arose, and secretly cut off the hem of Saul’s robe.
top_verses.original_text: Et dixerunt servi David ad eum: Ecce dies de qua locutus est Dominus ad te: Ego tradam tibi inimicum tuum, ut facias ei sicut placuerit in oculis tuis. Surrexit ergo David, et praecidit oram chlamydis Saul silenter.

top_verses.text: Blessed be the Lord the God of our fathers, who hath put this in the king’s heart, to glorify the house of the Lord, which is in Jerusalem,
top_verses.original_text: Benedictus Dominus Deus patrum nostrorum, qui dedit hoc in corde regis ut glorificaret domum Domini quae est in Jerusalem,

top_verses.text: And  the Lord said to Josue: Fear not, nor be thou dismayed: take with thee all the multitude of fighting men, arise and go up to the town of Hai. Behold I have delivered into thy hand the king thereof, and the people, and the city, and the land.
top_verses.original_text: Dixit autem Dominus ad Josue: Ne timeas, neque formides: tolle tecum omnem multitudinem pugnatorum, et consurgens ascende in oppidum Hai. Ecce tradidi in manu tua regem ejus et populum, urbemque et terram.

top_verses.text: Praise ye the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.
top_verses.original_text: Confitemini Domino dominorum, quoniam in aeternum misericordia ejus.

top_verses.text: O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.
top_verses.original_text: Benedicite, servi Domini, Domino: laudate et superexaltate eum in saecula.

top_verses.text: If so be they may present their supplication before the Lord, and may return every one from his wicked way: for great is the wrath and indignation which the Lord hath pronounced against this people.
top_verses.original_text: si forte cadat oratio eorum in conspectu Domini, et revertatur unusquisque a via sua pessima: quoniam magnus furor et indignatio est quam locutus est Dominus adversus populum hunc.

top_verses.text: Thus saith the Lord God: In the day. when he went down to hell, I brought in mourning, I covered him with the deep: and I withheld its rivers, and restrained the many waters: Libanus grieved for him, and all the trees of the field trembled.
top_verses.original_text: Haec dicit Dominus Deus: In die quando descendit ad inferos, induxi luctum: operui eum abysso, et prohibui flumina ejus, et coercui aquas multas: contristatus est super eum Libanus, et omnia ligna agri concussa sunt.

entity__jerusalem_zion_vul.title: Jerusalem & Mount Zion
entity__jerusalem_zion_vul.description: Ierusalem and Sion, the holy city and mountain of the Lord.

top_verses.text: And thou shalt say to them: Thus saith the Lord: Behold I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, and the kings of the race of David that sit upon his throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
top_verses.original_text: Et dices ad eos: Haec dicit Dominus: Ecce ego implebo omnes habitatores terrae hujus, et reges qui sedent de stirpe David super thronum ejus, et sacerdotes, et prophetas, et omnes habitatores Jerusalem, ebrietate.

top_verses.text: And the king and all the men that were with him went to Jerusalem to the Jebusites the inhabitants of the land: and they said to David: Thou shalt not come in hither unless thou take away the blind and the lame that say: David shall not come in hither.
top_verses.original_text: Et abiit rex, et omnes viri qui erant cum eo, in Jerusalem, ad Jebusaeum habitatorem terrae: dictumque est David ab eis: Non ingredieris huc, nisi abstuleris caecos et claudos dicentes: Non ingredietur David huc.

top_verses.text: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and that which shall be saved out of mount Sion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
top_verses.original_text: De Jerusalem quippe egredientur reliquiae, et quod salvetur de monte Sion: zelus Domini exercituum faciet hoc.

top_verses.text: And said to him: Take these vessels, and go, and put them in the temple that is in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be built in its place.
top_verses.original_text: dixitque ei: Haec vasa tolle, et vade, et pone ea in templo, quod est in Jerusalem, et domus Dei aedificetur in loco suo.

top_verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord of hosts the God of Israel: Behold I will bring upon Juda, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that I have pronounced against them, because I have spoken to them, and they have not heard: I have called to them, and they have not answered me.
top_verses.original_text: Idcirco haec dicit Dominus exercituum, Deus Israel: Ecce ego adducam super Juda et super omnes habitatores Jerusalem universam afflictionem quam locutus sum adversum illos, eo quod locutus sum ad illos, et non audierunt; vocavi illos, et non responderunt mihi.

top_verses.text: And Adonibezec said: Seventy kings having their fingers and toes cut off, gathered up the leavings of the meat under my table: as I have done, so hath God requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
top_verses.original_text: Dixitque Adonibezec: Septuaginta reges amputatis manuum ac pedum summitatibus colligebant sub mensa mea ciborum reliquias: sicut feci, ita reddidit mihi Deus. Adduxeruntque eum in Jerusalem, et ibi mortuus est.

top_verses.text: And I will stretch out my hand upon Juda, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem: and I will destroy out of this place the remnant of Baal, and the names of the wardens of the temples with the priests:
top_verses.original_text: Et extendam manum meam super Judam et super omnes habitantes Jerusalem: et disperdam de loco hoc reliquias Baal, et nomina aedituorum cum sacerdotibus;

top_verses.text: Yet there shall be left in it some that shall be saved, who shall bring away their sons and daughters: behold they shall come among you, and you shall see their way, and their doings: and you shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, in all things that I have brought upon it.
top_verses.original_text: tamen relinquetur in ea salvatio educentium filios et filias: ecce ipsi ingredientur ad vos, et videbitis viam eorum et adinventiones eorum, et consolabimini super malo quod induxi in Jerusalem, in omnibus quae importavi super eam.

entity__covenant_promise_vul.title: Divine Covenant & Promise
entity__covenant_promise_vul.description: The testament and solemn pact of God (Testamentum and Foedus).

top_verses.text: Thus saith the Lord: In an acceptable time I have heard thee, and in the day of salvation I have helped thee: and I have preserved thee, and given thee to be a covenant of the people, that thou mightest raise up the earth, and possess the inheritances that were destroyed:
top_verses.original_text: Haec dicit Dominus: In tempore placito exaudivi te, et in die salutis auxiliatus sum tui: et servavi te, et dedi te in foedus populi, ut suscitares terram, et possideres haereditates dissipatas;

top_verses.text: And they answered: We saw that the Lord is with thee, and therefore we said: Let there be an oath between us, and let us make a covenant,
top_verses.original_text: Qui responderunt: Vidimus tecum esse Dominum, et idcirco nos diximus: Sit juramentum inter nos, et ineamus foedus,

top_verses.text: I the Lord have called thee in justice, and taken thee by the hand, and preserved thee. And I have given thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles:
top_verses.original_text: Ego Dominus vocavi te in justitia, et apprehendi manum tuam, et servavi te: et dedi te in foedus populi, in lucem gentium,

top_verses.text: And the Lord said to Moses: Behold thou shalt sleep with thy fathers, and this people rising up will go a fornicating after strange gods in the land, to which it goeth in to dwell: there will they forsake me, and will make void the covenant, which I have made with them,
top_verses.original_text: Dixitque Dominus ad Moysen: Ecce tu dormies cum patribus tuis, et populus iste consurgens fornicabitur post deos alienos in terra, ad quam ingreditur ut habitet in ea: ibi derelinquet me, et irritum faciet foedus, quod pepigi cum eo.

top_verses.text: And this is the testament which I will make unto them after those days, saith the Lord. I will give my laws in their hearts, and on their minds will I write them:
top_verses.original_text: Hoc autem testamentum, quod testabor ad illos post dies illos, dicit Dominus, dando leges meas in cordibus eorum, et in mentibus eorum superscribam eas:

top_verses.text: He made an everlasting covenant with them, and he shewed them his justice and judgments.
top_verses.original_text: Testamentum aeternum constituit cum illis, et justitiam et judicia sua ostendit illis.

top_verses.text: Gather ye together his saints to him: who set his covenant before sacrifices.
top_verses.original_text: Congregate illi sanctos ejus, qui ordinant testamentum ejus super sacrificia.

top_verses.text: Therefore thus saith the Lord God: As I live, I will lay upon his head the oath he hath despised, and the covenant he hath broken.
top_verses.original_text: Propterea haec dicit Dominus Deus: Vivo ego, quoniam juramentum quod sprevit, et foedus quod praevaricatus est, ponam in caput ejus.

entity__faith_belief_vul.title: Faith & Belief
entity__faith_belief_vul.description: The grace of faith and theological belief (Fides and Credo).

top_verses.text: He that believeth God, taketh heed to the commandments: and he that trusteth in him, shall fare never the worse.
top_verses.original_text: Qui credit Deo attendit mandatis: et qui confidit in illo non minorabitur.

top_verses.text: Behold, he that is unbelieving, his soul shall not be right in himself: but the just shall live in his faith.
top_verses.original_text: Ecce qui incredulus est, non erit recta anima ejus in semetipso; justus autem in fide sua vivet.

top_verses.text: And they said to Jeremias: The Lord be witness between us of truth and faithfulness, if we do not according to every thing for which the Lord thy God shall send thee to us.
top_verses.original_text: Et illi dixerunt ad Jeremiam: Sit Dominus inter nos testis veritatis et fidei, si non juxta omne verbum in quo miserit te Dominus Deus tuus ad nos, sic faciemus:

top_verses.text: But they thought within themselves, saying: If we shall say, From heaven: he will say: Why then did you not believe him?
top_verses.original_text: At illi cogitabant intra se, dicentes: Quia si dixerimus: De caelo, dicet: Quare ergo non credidistis illi?

top_verses.text: He that believeth and is baptized, shall be saved: but he that believeth not shall be condemned.
top_verses.original_text: Qui crediderit, et baptizatus fuerit, salvus erit: qui vero non crediderit, condemnabitur.

top_verses.text: But he that discerneth, if he eat, is condemned; because not of faith. For all that is not of faith is sin.
top_verses.original_text: Qui autem discernit, si manducaverit, damnatus est: quia non ex fide. Omne autem, quod non est ex fide, peccatum est.

top_verses.text: When he shall come to be glorified in his saints, and to be made wonderful in all them who have believed; because our testimony was believed upon you in that day.
top_verses.original_text: cum venerit glorificari in sanctis suis, et admirabilis fieri in omnibus, qui crediderunt, quia creditum est testimonium nostrum super vos in die illo.

top_verses.text: And he saith to them: If I shall tell you, you will not believe me.
top_verses.original_text: Et ait illis: Si vobis dixero, non credetis mihi:

entity__righteousness_justification_vul.title: Righteousness & Justification
entity__righteousness_justification_vul.description: Justice, moral righteousness, and justification before God (Iustitia and Iustifico).

top_verses.text: Thus  saith the Lord: Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my justice to be revealed.
top_verses.original_text: Haec dicit Dominus: Custodite judicium, et facite justitiam, quia juxta est salus mea ut veniat, et justitia mea ut reveletur.

top_verses.text: Thy justice is as the mountains of God, thy judgments are a great deep. Men and beasts thou wilt preserve, O Lord:
top_verses.original_text: Justitia tua sicut montes Dei; judicia tua abyssus multa. Homines et jumenta salvabis, Domine,

top_verses.text: He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: his justice remaineth for ever and ever: his horn shall be exalted in glory.
top_verses.original_text: Dispersit, dedit pauperibus; justitia ejus manet in saeculum saeculi: cornu ejus exaltabitur in gloria.

top_verses.text: Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, and let them not rejoice over me.
top_verses.original_text: Judica me secundum justitiam tuam, Domine Deus meus, et non supergaudeant mihi.

top_verses.text: He that followeth justice and mercy, shall find life, justice, and glory.
top_verses.original_text: Qui sequitur justitiam et misericordiam inveniet vitam, justitiam, et gloriam.

top_verses.text: For the Lord is just, and hath loved justice: his countenance hath beheld righteousness.
top_verses.original_text: Quoniam justus Dominus, et justitias dilexit: aequitatem vidit vultus ejus.

top_verses.text: Then hear thou from heaven, and do justice to thy servants, so as to requite the wicked by making his wickedness fall upon his own head, and to revenge the just, rewarding him according to his justice.
top_verses.original_text: tu audies de caelo, et facies judicium servorum tuorum, ita ut reddas iniquo viam suam in caput proprium, et ulciscaris justum, retribuens ei secundum justitiam suam.

top_verses.text: If thou wilt walk clean and upright, he will presently awake unto thee, and will make the dwelling of thy justice peaceable:
top_verses.original_text: si mundus et rectus incesseris: statim evigilabit ad te, et pacatum reddet habitaculum justitiae tuae,
